senses.text: to make a fuss, to act up
senses.example: Hun skaber sig altid når hun skal i seng.
senses.example_translation: She always makes a fuss when she has to go to bed.

senses.example: Bussen og lastbilen kørte sammen i krydset.
senses.example_translation: The bus and the truck collided at the intersection.

senses.text: to drive out (from a garage, onto a road)
senses.example: Bilen kører ud fra garagen hver morgen.
senses.example_translation: The car drives out of the garage every morning.

senses.example: Vi kører ud med varer til kunderne om eftermiddagen.
senses.example_translation: We deliver goods to customers in the afternoon.

senses.example: Læreren fulgte op på elevernes spørgsmål efter timen.
senses.example_translation: The teacher followed up on the students' questions after the lesson.

senses.example: Sygdommen gav sig til kende med feber og træthed.
senses.example_translation: The illness manifested itself with fever and fatigue.

senses.example: Han slog igen, da de drillede ham.
senses.example_translation: He hit back when they teased him.

senses.example: Roserne slog ud i haven i går.
senses.example_translation: The roses bloomed in the garden yesterday.

senses.example: Jeg faldt for hende med det samme.
senses.example_translation: I fell for her immediately.

senses.example: Han falder for den samme undskyldning hver gang.
senses.example_translation: He falls for the same excuse every time.

senses.example: Hun faldt over en gammel bog på loftet.
senses.example_translation: She stumbled upon an old book in the attic.

senses.example: Katten gemmer sig inden under sofaen.
senses.example_translation: The cat hides under the sofa.

senses.example: Vi nåede frem til en løsning efter lang tids diskussion.
senses.example_translation: We arrived at a solution after a long discussion.

senses.example: Regningen lød på tre hundrede kroner.
senses.example_translation: The bill amounted to three hundred kroner.

senses.example: Han steg ned ad trappen med en tung kuffert.
senses.example_translation: He descended the stairs with a heavy suitcase.

senses.example: Jeg betaler af på mit lån hver måned.
senses.example_translation: I pay off my loan every month.

senses.example: Vi kører videre mod nord efter frokost.
senses.example_translation: We drive on north after lunch.

senses.example: Hun vil gerne forsøge sig som forfatter.
senses.example_translation: She would like to try her hand at being a writer.

senses.example: Jeg gør det kort, fordi jeg har travlt.
senses.example_translation: I'll be brief because I'm busy.

senses.example: Hunden ligger stille på gulvet.
senses.example_translation: The dog lies still on the floor.

senses.example: Børnene sad stille og lyttede til historien.
senses.example_translation: The children sat quietly and listened to the story.

senses.example: Der er en plet bag på skjorten.
senses.example_translation: There is a stain on the back of the shirt.

senses.example: Hun står bag sin ven i svære tider.
senses.example_translation: She stands behind her friend in difficult times.

senses.text: to be behind (something, as the cause)
senses.example: Politiet tror, at en gruppe står bag tyveriet.
senses.example_translation: The police believe that a group is behind the theft.

senses.example: Virksomheden trak sig ud af samarbejdet i sidste uge.
senses.example_translation: The company withdrew from the collaboration last week.

senses.example: Mødet trak sig ud og varede over tre timer.
senses.example_translation: The meeting dragged on and lasted over three hours.

senses.example: Han holdt fast i sin mening under mødet.
senses.example_translation: He stuck to his opinion during the meeting.

senses.example: Bilen kørte fast i mudderet.
senses.example_translation: The car got stuck in the mud.

senses.example: Mødet kører fast i detaljer.
senses.example_translation: The meeting gets bogged down in details.

senses.example: Bilen satte sig fast i mudderet.
senses.example_translation: The car got stuck in the mud.

senses.example: Min datter bor for sig selv i København.
senses.example_translation: My daughter lives by herself in Copenhagen.

senses.example: De bor sammen i en lille lejlighed.
senses.example_translation: They live together in a small apartment.

senses.example: Hans råd var til hjælp for mig.
senses.example_translation: His counsel was helpful to me.

senses.example: De gav hånd, da de mødtes.
senses.example_translation: They shook hands when they met.

senses.example: De flyttede sammen efter et halvt år.
senses.example_translation: They moved in together after six months.

senses.example: Hun fik til opgave at rydde op på værelset.
senses.example_translation: She was given the task of cleaning up the room.

senses.example: De ændrede ved aftalen i sidste øjeblik.
senses.example_translation: They changed the agreement at the last minute.

senses.example: Han rettede op på fejlen med det samme.
senses.example_translation: He corrected the mistake immediately.

senses.example: Jeg retter mig efter de nye regler på arbejdet.
senses.example_translation: I follow the new rules at work.

senses.example: Kritikken retter sig mod regeringens plan.
senses.example_translation: The criticism is directed at the government's plan.

senses.example: Spørgsmålet retter sig mod alle forældre.
senses.example_translation: The question is aimed at all parents.

senses.example: Jeg vender mig til den nye rutine.
senses.example_translation: I get used to the new routine.

senses.text: to notice, to have an eye for
senses.example: Hun har øje for detaljerne i maleriet.
senses.example_translation: She has an eye for the details in the painting.

senses.text: to take a long time (doing sth.)
senses.example: Han er længe om at spise morgenmad.
senses.example_translation: He takes a long time to eat breakfast.

senses.text: to open (itself, of a door, window)
senses.example: Døren åbnede sig langsomt.
senses.example_translation: The door opened slowly.

senses.example: Hun åbner sig aldrig for fremmede.
senses.example_translation: She never opens up to strangers.

senses.example: Jeg ser igennem dokumenterne inden mødet.
senses.example_translation: I look through the documents before the meeting.

senses.example: Hun så igennem bunken for at finde kvitteringen.
senses.example_translation: She looked through the pile to find the receipt.
